ValidationRule.description: Validates country name entered exactly matches approved country name in IM_Country__c. Implemented via VLOOKUP against the Name field on IM_Country__c. Requires Read access to IM_Country__c for all profiles responsible for Lead creation. Case sensitive.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The country name entered does not match our approved country list. Please enter the full country name as it appears. For example, "United States", "United Kingdom", "United Arab Emirates". Refer to the IM Countries list for the exact spelling.
